item.title: Homeschool Math Bundle, Grades 1–4
item.description: Three printable math packs in one download, covering grades 1 to 4. Multiplication facts 0–12, telling time from the hour to the minute, and Thanksgiving math with regrouping. Great value for homeschool families and teachers with mixed grades. Instant download: print it tonight, use it tomorrow.
